subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which raw-payload normalization branch should remain the canonical landing path after serialization and proof blockers are addressed?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same linked issue; one is mergeable but has a narrow serialization defect and no real proof, while the sibling has a broader normalization shape but is conflicting and proof-gated.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Use this PR as the candidate only if it adopts total serialization, adds a non-JSON raw-return regression, and includes accessible redacted real app-server/plugin proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 only if maintainers prefer its broader normalization boundary and it is made clean, reviewable, and proof-backed.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the candidate only if it adopts total serialization, adds a non-JSON raw-return regression, and includes accessible redacted real app-server/plugin proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on the Codex dynamic-tool bridge and adjacent middleware behavior involved in this decision.
